title: First N700ST main-line test reaches 170 km/h
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.note: THSRC reports that the first N700ST trainset reached the day's target of 170 km/h on its 16 November 2026 first main-line trial between Yanchao and Chiayi. The test checked interaction with track and overhead power. It recalls arrival on 15 August and plans public operation starting on 1 July 2027.
